NYC geography crosswalk (wide format)

Source: R/data.R
nyc_xwalk_wide_df.Rd

For every feature of every geography, the names of the overlapping features in each of the other fourteen geographies. One row per feature, one column per geography.

Usage

nyc_xwalk_wide_df

Format

nyc_xwalk_wide_df

A tibble with 1,154 rows and 17 columns:

primary_geo_id

ID of the primary geography (character). See nyc_xwalk_geographies_df.

primary_geo_name

Name of the primary feature (character).

cd,pp,dsny,fb,sd,hc,cc,nycongress,sa,ss,bid,nta,zipcode,hd,ibz

Names of the overlapping features in that geography, sorted and separated by ";", e.g. "MN01;MN03" (character). NA if none overlap, and in the primary geography's own column.

Source

Built with nycbuildxwalks, https://github.com/kjhealy/nycbuildxwalks, after the MODA-NYC crosswalks tool, https://github.com/MODA-NYC/nyc-geography-crosswalks.

Details

The same overlaps as nyc_xwalk_df, without areas, in the layout of the wide CSV files published by nycbuildxwalks and the MODA-NYC crosswalks tool. Use nyc_xwalk_df for intersection areas and shares. nyc_xwalk_df describes the method and gives the credits.

Author

Kieran Healy
